mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.users (id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, status, email_verified, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{emailVerified}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, status, email_verified, last_global_signout_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, status, email_verified, last_global_signout_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE email = #{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.users SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
